description: Read-only. Recommend builds from the Skill Harbor open directory for a task described in plain language, French or English. Pass the user's task exactly as written, never rewrite it into keywords yourself. Returns 3 to 5 builds with a one-sentence reason each: slug, title, price, verification status, and listing URL. The reason comes only from the listing itself, never from an assumed capability. Suspended builds are never recommended. Read full details with get_build, and the install material with get_install_package, only for a build the user picks from the recommendations. Do not present installation as automatic.

lang.description: 'en' or 'fr' (default 'en'). Language of the one-sentence reason for each recommendation.

task.description: The task to accomplish, in plain language, French or English. Required.

name: recommend_builds
